home.headline: Samuel Mbugua
aboutParagraphs: Samuel Mbugua is a masters student in the Bowers college of Computing and Information Science at Cornell University. He also holds a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Cornell.
His interest is in the intersection of tech and the built world.

updates.text: Joined the Cornell Student Assembly as a voting member of the Student Assembly Infrastructure Fund Commission.
Led a committee of 9 as Co-lead to organise the Cornell Africa Development Conference (CADC) 2020.

Recieved 1st place together with four orther students at the Digital Transformation Hackathon held by the Cornell SC Johnson College of Business. Proposal was imed at objective diagnosis of pain using EEG headsets in response to the opioid crisis.

Came in 2nd at the IBM Call for Code Hackathon held by the Cornell College of Engineering. Led a team of 4 in designing a mobile application aimed at reducing confusion during rescue operations after natural disasters occur especially in the developing regions of the world.

introParagraphs: Hello! My name is Samuel... I am an engineer who finds their place at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. I am mainly interested in the design and building process of both civil and data infrastructure.
